description_en: Queries the features that are supported by an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查询当前AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例支持的功能特性
name: DescribeSupportFeatures

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

SupportFeatureList.description_en:
The features supported by the instance. Valid values:

sample_data: sample dataset. For more information, see [Sample dataset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452278.html）.
diagnose_and_optimize: diagnostics and optimization. For more information, see [Diagnostics and optimization]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/323453.html）
SupportFeatureList.description_zh:
当前实例支持的功能特性。目前仅支持查询如下功能特性：

sample_data：样本数据集，更多介绍，请参见[样本数据集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452278.html）。
diagnose_and_optimize：诊断与优化，更多介绍，请参见[诊断与优化]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/323453.html）
